Thought: Looking at the carbon NMR spectra, I can identify the aromatic carbons which typically appear in the range of 100-160 ppm. Let me analyze the peaks:

166.40 ppm - This is likely a carbonyl carbon (C=O)
131.87 ppm - Aromatic carbon
129.70 ppm (2 carbons) - Aromatic carbons
129.01 ppm (2 carbons) - Aromatic carbons
129.00 ppm - Aromatic carbon
52.24 ppm - Non-aromatic (likely methoxy or similar)
43.47 ppm - Non-aromatic (aliphatic)
38.60 ppm - Non-aromatic (aliphatic)

Counting the aromatic carbons:
1 (131.87) + 2 (129.70) + 2 (129.01) + 1 (129.00) = 6 aromatic carbons
Final Answer: 6
